name: @polyth/mobile
description: Polyth Capacitor client for an existing Polyth runtime

scripts.sync: npm run assets && cap sync && node scripts/configure-ios-polyth-link.mjs && node scripts/bundle-package-assets.mjs
scripts.copy: npm run assets && cap copy && node scripts/bundle-package-assets.mjs
scripts.open:android: npm run assets && cap open android
scripts.open:ios: npm run assets && npm run native:ios && cap open ios
scripts.build:android: npm run assets && cap build android
scripts.build:ios: npm run assets && npm run native:ios && cap build ios
